questions.question: All participants ______ submit their feedback forms before leaving the workshop venue.
questions.explanation: must 表强制性要求，符合“必须提交”的语义。

questions.question: The interim financial report showed revenue ______ than analysts had projected.
questions.explanation: than 提示比较级，用 higher。

questions.question: Should the server overload during peak hours, please ______ the traffic to the backup site.
questions.explanation: please 后接动词原形；should 引导虚拟条件句。

questions.question: Ms. Garcia is the coordinator ______ presentation received the highest ratings from attendees.
questions.explanation: whose 表所属关系，修饰 presentation。

questions.question: Of the three software vendors evaluated, the committee selected the one that was ______ to integrate.
questions.explanation: of the three 表范围，用最高级 easiest。

questions.question: Neither the marketing team nor the product developers ______ informed about the launch delay.
questions.explanation: neither...nor 就近原则，developers 为复数用 were。

questions.question: Only after the compliance officer signed off ______ could the new feature be released.
questions.explanation: only 置于句首，主句部分倒装，过去时用 would。

questions.question: The audit committee eventually agreed ______ the scope of the upcoming internal review.
questions.explanation: agree on 表“就……达成一致”。

questions.question: The updated travel policy, ______ begins next quarter, was approved by the CFO last week.
questions.explanation: 先行词指物，非限定性定语从句缺主语，用 which。

questions.question: Field agents now spend significantly ______ on mileage reimbursements than they did last year.
questions.explanation: spend 后接不可数金额，用 less 表“更少”。

questions.question: We will activate the disaster recovery plan once the IT director ______ the system integrity.
questions.explanation: once 引导时间状语从句，用现在完成时表将来。

questions.question: The facilities department is responsible for ______ all safety equipment on a monthly basis.
questions.explanation: be responsible for 后接动名词 inspecting。

questions.question: Please store the master keys ______ the locked cabinet in the security office.
questions.explanation: 表示“在柜子里”用介词 in。

questions.question: ______ the shipment clears customs by Friday, we will not meet the client's delivery window.
questions.explanation: unless 表“除非”，后接肯定句表否定条件。

questions.question: ______ of the night-shift staff are permitted to take breaks in the designated lounge.
questions.explanation: 后接否定逻辑，只有 none 与句意一致。

questions.question: The upgraded firewall is expected ______ unauthorized access attempts by a substantial percentage.
questions.explanation: be expected to do sth. 为固定搭配。

questions.question: ______ the sudden power outage, the data center maintained full operational capacity.
questions.explanation: despite 表让步“尽管”，后接名词短语。

questions.question: The client inquired ______ the service-level agreement includes weekend support coverage.
questions.explanation: whether 引导宾语从句，表“是否”。

questions.question: The interns were divided into teams; ______ team was assigned a different market segment.
questions.explanation: each 作主语指“每个小组”，谓语用单数。

questions.question: The cargo was delayed ______ adverse weather conditions at the departure airport.
questions.explanation: be delayed by 表“被……延迟”，被动语态引导者用 by。

questions.question: Applicants who pass the language proficiency test ______ be scheduled for a second interview.
questions.explanation: 表将来将被安排，用一般将来时 will。

questions.question: ______ completing the mandatory ethics training, employees receive a certificate of completion.
questions.explanation: upon doing sth. 表“在完成……之后/之时”。

questions.question: The negotiation team reached consensus ______ the royalty rates for the licensed technology.
questions.explanation: reach consensus on 表“就……达成共识”。

questions.question: The analysts are reviewing the variances that ______ in the quarterly budget comparison.
questions.explanation: 描述季度预算对比中已出现的问题，用过去时 appeared。

questions.question: Visitors must present a government-issued ID ______ entering the research and development wing.
questions.explanation: before entering 意为“进入之前”。

questions.question: The survey results were tabulated ______ so that the product manager could identify trends immediately.
questions.explanation: 修饰动词 tabulated 用副词 electronically“以电子方式”。

questions.question: Had the logistics coordinator received the warehouse schedule earlier, they ______ the inbound shipments accordingly.
questions.explanation: had 引导的虚拟条件句，主句用 would have + 过去分词。

questions.question: ______ feedback is resolved more efficiently when it is submitted via the online portal.
questions.explanation: 名词作定语修饰 feedback，不加所有格。

questions.question: The procurement specialist compared the estimated lead times ______ the actual delivery dates.
questions.explanation: compare sth. against sth. 表“把……与……对照”。

questions.question: The revised dividend policy will be communicated to every shareholder ______ the annual general meeting.
questions.explanation: at the meeting 表“在会议上”。

questions.question: The exhibit signage was fabricated ______ clearly that passersby could grasp the brand message within seconds.
questions.explanation: so + that 引导结果状语从句，表“如此……以至于”。

questions.question: The quarterly webinar attracted registrants ______ than the previous session due to improved topic relevance.
questions.explanation: than 提示比较级，用 more 修饰可数名词复数。

questions.question: Should the main database experience latency, please ______ the read requests to the replica node.
questions.explanation: please 后接动词原形；should 引导虚拟条件句。

questions.question: Mr. Epstein is the supervisor ______ feedback consistently received the highest satisfaction scores.
questions.explanation: whose 表所属关系，修饰 feedback。

questions.question: Of the four office layouts tested, employees preferred the one that was ______ for collaborative work.
questions.explanation: of the four 表范围，用最高级 best suited。

questions.question: Neither the HR department nor the payroll team ______ notified of the changes to the tax withholding tables.
questions.explanation: neither...nor 就近原则，team 为单数用 was。

questions.question: Only after the legal department completed its review ______ could the partnership agreement be executed.
questions.explanation: only 置于句首，主句部分倒装，过去时用 did。

questions.question: The building management committee eventually agreed ______ the proposed renovation timeline for the lobby.
questions.explanation: agree to sth. 表“同意某项安排”。

questions.question: The updated remote-work policy, ______ takes effect on the first of next month, was reviewed by IT security.
questions.explanation: 先行词指物，非限定性定语从句缺主语，用 which。
